result.title: ElTab: Elastically Looped Tabular Transformers
result.summary: Tabular transformer models such as TabPFN achieve strong predictive performance but incur substantial inference costs, making them difficult to deploy in resource-constrained settings. While looped transformers reduce parameter count through weight sharing, they can lose significant predictive power when stopped early. To address this challenge, we introduce the Elastically Looped Tabular Transformer (ElTab), a single model trained to operate across different computational budgets through supervision at randomly sampled early exits. Across 30 OpenML classification datasets, a single ElTab model matches six depth-specific looped models while cutting training cost by more than half, and matches a 12-layer TabPFN-style baseline with 25% fewer inference FLOPs. These results show that elastic-depth training yields a single model that adapts to the deployment budget at hand, offering a favorable trade-off among predictive performance, storage, and computational cost.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ElTab，通过对随机早退位置施加监督，训练单一循环式表格 Transformer 适应不同计算预算，并在 30 个 OpenML 分类数据集上以更低训练与推理成本匹配特定深度模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽面向表格任务，其随机早退的弹性深度训练可能为 LVR 中循环计算预算、早停决策与长度泛化提供训练监督线索，值得核查。
